description: Top-level `expected` keys that are DATA under test, not assertion names, so no driver names them as a literal. Each entry needs a reason. check_expected_keys_read.py reports an entry as STALE once a driver does read the key, so a real assertion landing here surfaces its own cleanup rather than leaving a permanent exemption.

allow.reason: `expected` here is a map from FIELD NAME to whether that field is redacted by the default key list. The keys are the inputs under test — the driver iterates the map rather than naming any single field — so a literal-mention check cannot see them. Adding a field means adding a case, not an assertion.
Same shape: `expected` is a payload-shaped map of field name to post-redaction value, iterated by the driver. These are data, not assertion names.
